description: Download one attachment from an iCloud Mail message as an embedded binary resource. Use the 1-based index shown by apple_mail_get_message. Reads the message without marking it read. Defaults to a 10 MiB attachment limit (maximum 20 MiB). Needs ICLOUD_USERNAME + ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD (app-specific password), and ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS unless the Apple ID is an @icloud.com/@me.com/@mac.com address.

mailbox.description: Mailbox holding the message (default inbox); path or alias.

maxBytes.description: Maximum decoded attachment bytes to return (default 10485760; maximum 20971520).

uidValidity.description: The mailbox uidValidity returned alongside the uids. When given, the call is refused if the mailbox was renumbered since (an old uid could then name a different message).

name: apple_mail_download_attachment
title: Download an iCloud Mail attachment
